name: Mea
source:
A senior member of the Demon Lord's Army. A member of the demon tribe. She has strong magical power and is good at offensive magic.
She is sensational, loves stimulation, and likes to act wildly.
She thinks that humans are just toys to amuse him, and tries to torture the main character.
